description:
Hi! I’m Oscar, a 3D artist and game developer from Barcelona. I’ve shipped multiplayer indie games, so I’m used to turning ideas into polished, playable prototypes fast.

I bring 3D art, real-time visuals and interactive design, and I’d love to work on a challenge where visualization or gamification helps people explore space and Earth data.

Looking for teammates with skills in data science, web/backend development, science or engineering, and pitching/storytelling. Let’s build something cool!
